package parse

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestNestedExpressions(t *testing.T) {
	expr, err := NewExpression(` pre{{regexp.replace(email.local(external.email), "^(.*)$", "user-$1")}}post `)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	values, err := expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"email": {"Alice <alice@example.com>", "bob@example.com"}}, func(ns, name string) error {
		require.Equal(t, "external", ns)
		require.Equal(t, "email", name)
		return nil
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"preuser-alicepost", "preuser-bobpost"}, values)
	expr, err = NewExpression(`{{regexp.replace("abc", "a", "z")}}`)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	values, err = expr.Interpolate(nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"zbc"}, values)
	expr, err = NewExpression(`{{regexp.replace("abc", "x", "z")}}`)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = expr.Interpolate(nil)
	require.True(t, trace.IsNotFound(err))
}
func TestExpressionValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []string{`{{internal}}`, `{{internal.foo.bar}}`, `{{internal.foo["bar"]}}`, `{{internal["foo"]["bar"]}}`, `{{unknown.foo}}`, `{{"abc"}}`, `{{123}}`, `{{regexp.match("a")}}`, `{{email.local(regexp.match("a"))}}`, `{{regexp.replace(external.foo,external.pattern,"x")}}`, `{{regexp.replace("x","(","y")}}`, `{{email.local(external.foo,external.bar)}}`, `{{regexp.match(external.foo)}}`, `{{external.foo`, `external.foo}}`} {
		_, err := NewExpression(input)
		require.Truef(t, trace.IsBadParameter(err), "%s: %v", input, err)
	}
	_, err := NewExpression(`{{` + strings.Repeat("email.local(", 101) + `"x"` + strings.Repeat(")", 101) + `}}`)
	require.True(t, trace.IsBadParameter(err))
	expr, err := NewExpression(`{{external.foo}}`)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = expr.Interpolate(nil)
	require.True(t, trace.IsNotFound(err))
	require.Contains(t, err.Error(), "external.foo")
}
func TestMatcherAST(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		input, value string
		want         bool
	}{{`a*b`, `axxb`, true}, {`a.b`, `axb`, false}, {`^a.*b$`, `axxb`, true}, {`pre{{regexp.match("^a+$")}}post`, `preaaapost`, true}, {`pre{{regexp.not_match("x")}}post`, `preaaapost`, true}} {
		m, err := NewMatcher(tc.input)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, tc.want, m.Match(tc.value))
	}
	for _, input := range []string{`{{external.foo}}`, `{{email.local("a@b")}}`, `{{regexp.match(external.foo)}}`, `{{regexp.not_match("x","y")}}`} {
		_, err := NewMatcher(input)
		require.True(t, trace.IsBadParameter(err), "%s: %v", input, err)
	}
}

item.text:
Implemented a typed expression AST with nested evaluation, strict variable and function validation, regex matching, and a depth limit. Trait and PAM interpolation now validate namespaces and report empty results consistently; PAM missing-trait warnings omit claim names.

Parser and targeted services tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean. The `lib/srv` test could not build in this environment because required C headers and SQLite declarations are unavailable.
